description: Genesis delegates bounded work to an independent external A2A agent. The agent returns a result. Genesis records provenance. Genesis verifies the relevant result independently. Mission succeeds only after verification.

reference_agent.computes: SHA-256 hash of the input text

federation_flow: Reference agent computes SHA-256 and returns Task with status=COMPLETED
FederationService returns FederationResult with ok=true, result=<hash>, provenance
Genesis verification (hash-match check) independently confirms the result
